description: This file contains localization strings for the Select2 JavaScript plugin in Norwegian Bokmål (nb). It defines translations for various user interface messages used within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message for failed result loading.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating input length exceeds maximum.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating input length is below minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message shown when loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.
